title: Prediction Market Analyzer
description: Analyzes a binary or scalar prediction market position. Computes PnL, Kalshi parabolic fees, implied probability, break-even probability, no-vig fair value, expected value, Kelly criterion sizing, American and decimal odds, Brier score, and log score. Supports Polymarket, Kalshi, CME Event Contracts, and Robinhood. Zero PII. Client-side.

mcp_tool_definition.name: analyze_prediction_market
mcp_tool_definition.description: Analyzes a binary or scalar prediction market position. Computes PnL, implied probability, break-even probability, no-vig fair value, expected value, Kelly criterion sizing, decimal and American odds, Brier score, and log score. Supports Polymarket (2% flat), Kalshi (parabolic 7% peak), CME Event Contracts, and Robinhood. Browser-based, client-side only. Zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/chaingraph/art-211-prediction-market-analyzer.html for interactive use.

entry_price.description: Entry price per contract (0-1 for binary, or per unit for scalar)

payout.description: Payout per contract on win (typically 1.00 for binary)

settlement.description: Actual settlement value (binary: 0 or 1; scalar: settlement price)

unit_value.description: Payout per unit above/below strike (scalar mode)
